ideas.title: The Impact of Government Fraud on Public Programs
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of government fraud on public programs, including the Sun Relocation Deal and Medicare programs in Southern California.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of government fraud cases
questions: What is the extent of government fraud?
How does it impact public programs?
ideas.insight: Government fraud can have significant impacts on public programs, including financial losses and decreased public trust.
